scope: Revised test-only browser benchmark plan; approval is not execution evidence or a production, accessibility, server diagnostic, or physical-paint claim.
resolution: Prior target observability blocker resolved: exact A/B type text and complete unique fixture node button set are required after each event; a mismatch makes the run incomplete.

Prior freshness blocker resolved: a pre-armed observer requires a fresh commit-phase rendered-view marker and matching mount, authority, document, base, draft and next generation, with continuity checked through both sequential callbacks and invalidation on interruptions.
The Lean model explicitly remains abstract and neither derives the percentile nor proves correspondence to runtime.
